        return typed_dict_to_dict(typ)
    
    # Get module and qualname

    result: TypeDict = {

    }
    
    # Handle generic types with element types
    if is_generic(typ):
        # Get the origin type and its arguments
        origin = getattr(typ, '__origin__', None)
        args = getattr(typ, '__args__', None)
        if args:
